descriptionMarkdown:
- All blueprints are rotable and exansable, stations are parameterized
- You have 2 scopes of wires: [item=red-wire]local, [item=green-wire]global (inter-block)

##### **Designations:**
- Stop type: [virtual-signal=signal-P] (provider) / [virtual-signal=signal-C] (consumer)
- Vertical pos: [virtual-signal=signal-T] (top) / [virtual-signal=signal-B] (bottom)
- Horizontal pos: [virtual-signal=signal-L] (left) / [virtual-signal=signal-R] (right)

##### **Updates:**

- ##### **2.1.0 (24.04.2026):**

- Reduce print size by using tilable concrete/hazard concrete
- Removed old prints, changed hierarchy, moved some prints different books
- Fixed some prints tiling / missing rails and so on

- ##### **2.0.0 (unknown):**
- Switch to new 2.0 rails
- A lot of changes
